researchQuestion: Why do raw-frequency ensemble means show K1>K3>K2? Is it sampling, selection, or hidden structure?
answer: The ordering is NOT present in the full pre-selection population. It is CREATED by the SelectAndClassify retention pipeline. P1 preferentially retains higher-mean profiles; K2 enters P1 at 75% (vs 55% K1, 50% K3). Branch composition creates the direction flip.
